Backend: 8/8 new pytest tests for /api/chat/conversations/{user_id} auto-seed all PASS (29/29 total across full backend suite with zero regressions). Second call is idempotent (exactly 1 Anjali + 1 Priya, same conversation_id set). /api/chat/messages/{conv_id} returns 9 (Anjali) and 10 (Priya) seeded messages. This conversation is now read-only. If you experienced inappropriate behavior, you can still report this user from the menu above.', and 0 visible composer text inputs (composer correctly disabled). /history tab still shows both Anjali Iyer (Unmatched) and Priya Bhatia (Unmatched) rows. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors. Deprecated packages detected: NONE for this feature. SafeAreaView issues detected: NONE. Mocked APIs: Auth (Email OTP returned in response) — used as documented.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-seed in /app/backend/server.py:2723-2726 is correctly wrapped in best-effort try/except so a seed failure never blocks the conversations response — good defensive design.

chat_service.get_conversations at /app/backend/chat_service.py:195-202 correctly excludes conversations the CURRENT user unmatched (unmatched_by != user_id), so only the OTHER-party unmatched cases appear in the Chat tab — matches the product spec.

Sorting at /app/backend/chat_service.py:233-238 is solid: active_pending bucket sorted by last_message_at desc, unmatched bucket sorted by unmatched_at desc, then concatenated to push unmatched to bottom. Verified via E2E ordering check.

ConversationItem at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/chat.tsx:1143-1219 correctly drives off both conversation.is_unmatched and conversation.status === 'unmatched' (defensive OR), renders the Unmatched badge as a separate branch from Pending (no overlap), uses unmatched_at for the time stamp instead of last_message_at, and routes the tap via setSelectedConversation which then mounts GiftedChatScreen with isReadOnly=true. testID 'conversation-row-{other_user_id}' is reliable for automation.
